title: Deploy approval from either conductor (Air runs it), with rollback and a checkable scope
acceptance: AGENTS.md defines how a production deploy, rollback, remote D1 migration, secret or production-data change approved in either conductor's session is recorded (owner's exact words, approved origin/main SHA, the PRs in scope, each named change) and when the Air may act on it without asking again.

The record cannot be used twice or after it goes stale (single-use marker the Air writes, an expiry), and the Air compares the deploy range against the listed PRs mechanically; if anything differs it asks the owner.

A safeguard against a record no owner gave (agents post as the owner's account): at minimum the Air posts a one-line notice to the owner right before running, and Lanes and subagents never write the record.
The deployment runbook, "Never granted" and agent-prompts/README.md agree with the rule.
nextAction: Owner approved the idea on 2026-11-03 ("Yes, allow it with those safeguards", #721 issuecomment-6617021324) and then chose to split it out of #721 after three review rounds found gaps. Draft the rule with rollback, scope-by-PR, single use, expiry and the pre-run notice; owner-gated (AGENTS.md). Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

Review rounds 1-3 on the first draft (in #721's history before the split): forgeable comment record, no rollback form, free-text scope, runbook in-session line, Used/expiry markers.
